title: Implementation Record
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact. Output of code-implementer. Records the code changes actually made in response to an approved patch_plan, including provenance, the files touched, and a summary of what changed. Must reference the originating patch_plan to prove nothing was implemented ad hoc.

from_patch_plan_ref.description: Reference (path or ID) to the patch_plan artifact that authorised this implementation. Required — proves the change is traceable.

condition_id.description: Optional experiment condition this implementation targets.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of what was implemented.

files_changed.description: List of files actually touched during implementation.

path.description: Relative file path that was changed.

change_type.description: What actually happened to this file.

notes.description: Any important implementation note for this file.

out_of_scope_writes_blocked.description: True if the scope-guard (scope_guard.py / permission-scope-guard.js) blocked at least one attempted write outside the agent's stage scope during this session.

git_sha.description: Git SHA of the commit capturing these changes, when available.

caveats.description: Any known limitations, deferred items, or follow-ups the implementer flagged.
